level: 1 (chemical qualification only; no docking run in this script)
source: ZINC (files.docking.org/2D), reactivity A/B/C/E, purchasability A/B (in stock)
selection_rule: top 300 by ECFP4/Morgan Tanimoto similarity to seed (radius 2, 2048 bits), descending, ties broken by ZINC ID ascending, restricted to [0.3, 0.95) -- pre-specified and frozen in CATALOGUE_BASELINE_SCOPE_v1.0.md before this script was run

gates.deduplication: globally across all downloaded tranches, by this project's own isomeric canonical SMILES; first occurrence retained (ZINC's own dedup/property metadata not trusted)
gates.brenk: only the single seed-position dibrominated-core aniline occurrence is allowlisted
